item.title: DARON MALAKIAN Breaks Silence on Why SYSTEM OF A DOWN Won't Release New Album: 'Where Do You Pick Up From?'
item.description: Daron Malakian, guitarist and one of the founding members of System of a Down, recently shared his thoughts on why the band probably will not release a new studio album anytime soon.

item.title: Korn Announces 30th Anniversary Concert with Star-Studded Lineup
item.description: Korn isn’t one to let their 30th anniversary of that self-titled debut just slip by quietly. They’ve decided to throw a massive bash at BMO Stadium in Los Angeles on October 5, 2024.
